verdict.rationale: Capacities' export docs say properties become front matter and collections become CSV files, making exports "fully human- and machine-readable" for reuse in other apps. Front-matter files indicate Markdown export, and scheduled automated full exports support an archive that outlives the vendor. missing for 10: explicit naming of Markdown as the export format in the export snippets, any JSON export option, details on how links/block references survive export, independent or hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.
